stories.title: Russell Brand trial hears rape allegation from Soho bar
stories.line: Russell Brand is on trial at Southwark Crown Court facing allegations of rape and sexual assault, with prosecutors describing his conduct and alleged normalisation of bad behaviour.

stories.title: Lula wins Brazil's presidency; Flavio Bolsonaro refuses to concede
stories.line: Lula won Brazil's presidential runoff, defeating far-right challenger Flavio Bolsonaro, whose camp has not conceded.

stories.title: DOJ sues over Alaska Senate race; reports say Trump directed the lawsuit
stories.line: The DOJ is suing over Alaska's Senate race, alleging a same-name candidate could confuse voters, and reports say Trump directed the suit.

stories.title: November 3 midterms will decide control of Congress for Trump's final two years
stories.line: Voters on November 3 decide which party controls Congress for the second half of Trump's term, with all 435 House seats and 35 Senate seats up.

stories.title: Anthropic files for U.S. IPO, reporting an $80.7B first-half loss
stories.line: Anthropic has filed for a U.S. IPO, disclosing an $80.7B net loss on $16.3B revenue in the first half of 2026.
